DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。相談の予約で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you arrange a consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語を助けてくれる友人と来たいです。二人なので予約を二件取ればよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日本語の理解を助ける友人と相談に来たいので、二件の予約が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to come with a friend who helps me understand Japanese. Since there will be two of us, I would like to ask whether I should book two appointments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need two appointments because you want to attend the consultation with a friend who helps you understand Japanese. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談する方はお二人ですか。友人もご自身の手続きを相談しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will both of you be seeking advice? Will your friend also be asking about their own procedures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談は私だけです。友人は説明を聞く手伝いで、自分の相談はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談するのは自分だけで、友人は説明を聞く手伝いをし、本人の相談はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only I need advice. My friend will help me understand the explanation and has no consultation of their own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that only you need advice, and that your friend will help you understand the explanation but has no consultation of their own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談者と同行者を分けて伝えましょう。同席できるかは担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish between the person seeking advice and the person accompanying them. I will check with the person in charge whether your friend can sit in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が来れば職員の通訳が不要になると勝手に決めず、私が理解できる方法も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人が来るだけで通訳対応が不要になるとは決めず、自分が理解できる説明方法も相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not want to assume that having my friend there means I will not need an interpreter provided by the staff. I would also like to discuss how the explanation can be made understandable to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you do not assume your friend's attendance makes interpreting support unnecessary, and that you also want to discuss a way of explaining things that you can understand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 希望する言語や、特に難しい内容があればお知らせください。対応方法を担当と確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please let us know your preferred language and anything you find particularly difficult. We can check with the person in charge about how to assist you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書類の条件が難しいです。友人に全部任せるのではなく、私本人が内容を理解して返事をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類の条件が難しいので、友人に任せきりにせず、自分で理解して返事をしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The conditions in the documents are difficult for me. Rather than leaving everything to my friend, I want to understand the content myself and give my own answers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the conditions in the documents are difficult and that you want to understand them and answer yourself instead of leaving everything to your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約希望はご本人の相談一件、友人一人の同席希望、ご本人へわかりやすく説明する希望、と記録しました。友人自身の相談枠は作っていません。日時と同席の可否は担当の確認待ちです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have recorded your requests as one consultation for you, attendance by one friend, and an explanation that is easy for you to understand. I have not created a separate consultation slot for your friend. The date, time and whether your friend may attend are awaiting confirmation from the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その希望で合っています。相談は私の一件で、友人の同席希望と私が理解して返事をする希望を添えたのですね。二件は申し込まず、日時と同席の回答を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人一件の相談に友人同席と本人が理解して返事する希望を添えたという記録を確認し、二件は申し込まず日時と同席の回答を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those requests are correct. You have added my requests for my friend to attend and for me to understand and answer myself to my one consultation, right? I will not apply for two appointments. I will wait for the response about the date, time and my friend's attendance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the record is for one consultation for you with requests for your friend to attend and for you to understand and answer yourself. Say you will not apply for two appointments and will await the response about the date, time and attendance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一件の相談希望として担当に渡します。友人の同席や通訳対応が確定したという記録にはしていません。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on as a request for one consultation. I have not recorded your friend's attendance or interpreting support as confirmed. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察に遅れたと思って来ました。案内には二つの時刻があり、どちらへ先に行くのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察に遅れたと思って来たが、案内に二つの時刻があるので先に行く場所を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came thinking I was late for my doctor's appointment. The instructions show two times, and I would like to confirm where I should go first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you came thinking you were late for your doctor's appointment, but the instructions show two times, so you want to confirm where to go first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内の見出しを見ましょう。時刻の横には何と書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at the headings on the instructions. What does it say next to each time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 早い方は検査で、遅い方は診察でした。私は遅い方だけ見て家を出ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 早い時刻は検査、遅い時刻は診察で、遅い方だけ見て家を出たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The earlier time was for a test, and the later one was for the doctor's appointment. I left home after looking only at the later time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the earlier time is for a test and the later time is for the doctor's appointment, and that you left home after looking only at the later time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査の受付について担当に確認します。検査はもう受けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the person in charge about checking in for the test. Have you had the test yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。今から検査を飛ばして診察へ行ってよいとは思わないので、次の指示を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検査は未受検で、勝手に飛ばして診察へ行かず次の指示を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I do not assume I can now skip the test and go to the doctor, so I would like to hear what I should do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not had the test and want to hear the next instructions rather than skipping it and going to the doctor on your own initiative. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予定と現在の状況を担当へ伝えます。検査前の準備の案内は持っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the person in charge about your schedule and current situation. Do you have the instructions for preparing for the test?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この紙です。準備したことは説明できますが、時刻を間違えたので、今日受けられると自己判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 準備の紙を示して準備した内容を説明し、時刻を間違えたので今日受けられるとは自己判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is the sheet. I can explain what I did to prepare, but since I got the time wrong, I will not decide for myself that I can have the test today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the preparation sheet, explain what you did to prepare, and say you will not decide for yourself that you can have the test today because you got the time wrong. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が順序と対応を確認します。案内を持ったまま、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check the order and how to proceed. Please wait here with your instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 検査前で、診察時刻だけ見たと説明します。準備の紙も見せて、今日の受診順序を担当に決めてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 検査前で診察時刻だけ見たことと準備の紙を示し、今日の受診順序を担当者に確認してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I have not had the test and looked only at the doctor's appointment time. I will also show the preparation sheet and ask the person in charge to decide the order of today's visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain you have not had the test and looked only at the doctor's appointment time, show the preparation sheet, and ask the person in charge to check the order of today's visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認してご案内しますので、お待ちください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait while we check and guide you. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 非通知の着信が何度も来ます。出ていないので相手はわかりませんが、履歴を見て相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 非通知の着信が繰り返されており、応答していない着信履歴について相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I keep getting calls from a withheld number. I have not answered, so I do not know who is calling, but I would like to discuss the call history with you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about your history of repeated unanswered calls from a withheld number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 着信の日時は記録されていますか。通話やメッセージで何か言われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are the dates and times of the calls recorded? Has anyone said anything to you in a call or message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 着信履歴はあります。電話には出ていませんし、メッセージもありません。脅されたという話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 着信履歴はあるが通話もメッセージもなく、脅す発言を聞いたわけではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the call history. I have not answered any of the calls, and there are no messages. I am not saying that I have been threatened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a call history but no conversations or messages, and have not heard any threatening remarks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 着信した事実と、相手の用件が不明なことを分けましょう。いつごろ続いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate the fact that calls came in from the fact that the caller's purpose is unknown. When have these calls been occurring?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方に三件、今日は二件です。記録では二日分だけで、ずっと前から続いているとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日夕方三件と今日二件の二日分を示し、それより前から続いたとは説明しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There were three yesterday evening and two today. My records cover only these two days, so I will not say this has been going on for a long time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the three calls yesterday evening and the two today, covering two days, and say you will not describe them as having continued before then. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録した範囲で説明してください。ご自身で相手を特定しようとして何か操作しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain only what your records show. Have you done anything on your device to try to identify the caller yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: していません。検索で見つけた業者へ端末情報を渡さず、通信の相談先とこちらで必要な対応を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分で相手を特定すると申し出る業者に情報を渡さず、通信事業者への相談方法を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I do not want to give my device information to a company I found through a search. I would like to ask whom to contact about the phone service and what action is needed here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not give information to a company offering to identify the caller and that you want to know how to consult your telecommunications provider. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 昨日三件、今日二件、計五件で全て未応答、メッセージなしと記録しました。「脅す発言があった」とは書いていません。通信設定の相談と、発言を受けた場合の相談は分けて進められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have recorded three calls yesterday and two today, five in total, all unanswered and with no messages. I have not written that there were threatening remarks. We can deal separately with advice about phone settings and advice if you receive such remarks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 計五件で未応答、メッセージなしという記録で合っています。聞いていない発言や相手を推測せず、この二日分の履歴で担当と通信の相談先に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 計五件で全て未応答、メッセージなしという読み返しを確認し、発言や相手を推測せず二日分の履歴で相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The record of five calls in total, all unanswered and with no messages, is correct. Without guessing what was said or who the caller is, I will check with the person in charge and the phone service contact using this two-day call history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the readback of five calls in total, all unanswered and with no messages. Say that you will seek advice using the two-day call history without guessing the caller's identity or any remarks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送のことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りた本を返送します。中に借りた時のメモを入れましたが、返す前に見直したいので、まだ封をしないでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた本を返送するが、中に入れたメモを見直すため封をする前に確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending back a borrowed book. I put in a note from when I borrowed it, but I want to review it before returning it. May I leave the package unsealed for now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are returning a borrowed book and ask to check the note inside before sealing the package because you want to review it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お預かり前ですので、ご自身で中身を確認してください。何が気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not accepted the package yet, so please check the contents yourself. What concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メモの裏に、別の人の連絡先を書いていました。本と一緒に送る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メモの裏に別の人の連絡先があり、本と一緒に送る必要はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote someone else's contact details on the back of the note. There is no need to send those with the book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that someone else's contact details are on the back of the note and do not need to be sent with the book. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 不要なメモを取り出し、本に返却先の情報が合っているか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Take out the unnecessary note and check that the book's return address information is correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本の持ち主へのお礼は伝えたいです。連絡先のある紙を使わず、新しい紙にお礼だけ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: お礼は伝えたいので連絡先のある紙は使わず、新しい紙にお礼だけ書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to thank the book's owner. I will write only my thanks on a new sheet instead of using the paper with the contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to express your thanks, so you will use a new sheet to write only your thanks instead of the paper with contact details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 用意できたら梱包を確認しましょう。本の間にも紙が残っていないか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you are ready, let us check the packaging. Please also check that no paper is left between the pages.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: しおりにした請求書も挟まっていました。自分の物なので取り出し、本のページを傷めないように確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: しおりにしていた自分の請求書も取り出し、ページを傷めず残った紙がないか確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was also a bill I had used as a bookmark. It belongs to me, so I will take it out and check carefully without damaging the pages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will also remove your own bill that you used as a bookmark and check for remaining papers without damaging the pages. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本以外に必要な物だけを入れてください。確認後に封をして、宛先をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Put in only the things that need to go with the book. After checking, seal the package and confirm the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古いメモと請求書を抜き、お礼の紙と本だけ入れます。返却先を確かめてから発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古いメモと請求書を抜いて本とお礼の紙だけを入れ、返却先を確認して発送すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will remove the old note and the bill, leaving only the book and the thank-you note. I will check the return address before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will remove the old note and bill, put in only the book and thank-you note, check the return address and send the package. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備が整いましたら受付へお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it to the counter when it is ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座のことで何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 覚えのない入金がありました。収入だと思って使う前に、取引の表示を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 覚えのない入金があり、新しい収入として使う前に取引表示を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a deposit I do not recognize. Before treating it as income and spending it, I would like to check how the transaction is displayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that there is a deposit you do not recognize and you want to check the transaction display before spending it as new income. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入金の日付と表示を見せてください。返金を待っている取引はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the deposit date and transaction description. Are you waiting for a refund on any transaction?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 返品した買い物があります。ただ、入金は購入額より少ないので、同じ返金かはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返品した買い物はあるが入金が購入額より少なく、同じ取引の返金かは分からないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I returned something I bought. However, the deposit is less than the purchase price, so I do not know whether it is the refund for that purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you returned a purchase but the deposit is less than the purchase price, so you do not know whether it is a refund for that transaction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この控えでは購入三千円のうち八百円分だけを返品し、その八百円を返すとあります。入金が三千円より少ない理由にはなりますが、この入金と同一かは別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This receipt says that of a 3,000-yen purchase, you returned only 800 yen's worth and will receive that 800 yen back. That would explain why the deposit is less than 3,000 yen, but we should separately confirm whether it is this deposit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内を見たら、一部だけ返品していました。全部の代金が戻ると思っていたのは私の勘違いかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内を確認したら一部返品だったので、全額が戻ると思ったことが勘違いかもしれないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: When I checked the notice, I saw that I had returned only part of the purchase. I may have been mistaken in thinking the entire purchase price would be refunded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the notice shows it was a partial return, so you may have been mistaken in expecting a full refund. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返品した部分の金額と、返金方法をお店に確認してください。口座の表示については担当が確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the amount for the returned items and the refund method with the store. The person in charge can check the account transaction display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店の案内と入金額は合っていますが、表示だけで店からと断定せず、担当に確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店の案内と入金額は合うが店からの返金とは断定せず、担当者に確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The amount in the store's notice matches the deposit, but I do not want to conclude from the display alone that it came from the store. I would like the person in charge to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the store's notice and the deposit amount match, but you are not certain it is a refund from the store, and ask the person in charge to check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照会メモに「購入全額より入金は少ない。一部返品の案内額とは一致。入金元は未確認」と分けて記入しました。金額の一致と、返金元が確認できたことは別として担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: In the inquiry note, I have recorded these separately: the deposit is less than the full purchase price; it matches the amount in the partial-return notice; the source of the deposit is unconfirmed. I will explain to the person in charge that a matching amount and confirmation of the refund's source are separate matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一部返品の案内と入金を見せます。新しい収入として足さず、返金かを確認してから家計に記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一部返品の案内と入金を示し、新しい収入には加えず、返金か確認してから家計に記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the partial-return notice and the deposit. I will not add it as new income; I will record it in my household accounts after confirming whether it is a refund.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the partial-return notice and the deposit, refrain from adding it as new income, and record it in your household accounts after confirming whether it is a refund. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。取引の担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge of transactions. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。食材選びで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you choose food?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は家の調理器が使えません。温めずに食べられる物を、表示を見て選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 調理器具が使えないため、温めずに食べられる食事を選びたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My cooking equipment at home is not working today. I would like to look at the labels and choose something I can eat without heating.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot use your cooking equipment and ask for help choosing a meal you can eat without heating. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お湯や電子レンジも使えない予定ですか。持ち帰ってすぐ食べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you also be unable to use hot water or a microwave? Will you eat it as soon as you get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらも使えません。帰ってすぐ食べますが、常温の棚にあるだけで調理不要とは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: お湯も電子レンジも使えず、常温保存ができることと調理不要であることを区別したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I cannot use either. I will eat as soon as I get home, but I will not assume that something needs no cooking just because it is on a room-temperature shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot use hot water or a microwave and want to distinguish between food that can be stored at room temperature and food that needs no cooking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存方法と調理方法は別に確認しましょう。どの品が候補ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check storage instructions and preparation instructions separately. Which products are you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この袋はお湯を入れる案内がありました。今日は合わないので、開けてそのまま食べられる表示の候補を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: お湯が必要な商品は買わず、開けるだけで食べられる候補を教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This packet says to add hot water. It will not work for today, so I would like to see options labeled as ready to eat straight from the package.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for options you can eat just by opening them, saying you will not buy products that need hot water. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示を比べられます。食器も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can compare the labels. Do you also need dishes or utensils?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家に皿はあります。食器を買い足すより、今ある皿で食べられる一食分を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 皿は持っているので、手持ちの食器を使って一食分だけ用意したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have plates at home. Rather than buying more dishes, I will choose enough for one meal that I can eat using the plates I already have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you already have plates and want to prepare just one meal using the dishes you own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 量と必要な準備を考えてお選びください。保存方法もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose with the quantity and necessary preparation in mind. Check the storage instructions as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 調理不要の表示を見て一食分だけ買います。お湯が必要な品は戻し、家の皿で食べられる物にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 調理不要の一食分を選び、お湯が必要な商品は戻して、持っている皿を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check for a no-cooking-needed label and buy just one meal. I will put back the item that needs hot water and choose something I can eat on my own plates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose one meal that needs no cooking, put back the product requiring hot water, and use the plates you already have. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示をご一緒に確認します。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us check the labels together. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 犬の水皿をベンチの近くに置いたら、共用の器だと思われました。自分の持ち物だと説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬用に持参した水皿を共用の器と思われたので、自分の持ち物だと説明したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I put my dog's water bowl near the bench, someone thought it was a shared bowl. I would like to explain that it belongs to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help explaining that the water bowl you brought for your dog belongs to you because someone mistook it for a shared bowl. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 皿はご自身で持参したものですか。犬用だとわかる場所にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you bring the bowl yourself? Is it in a place where people can tell it is for your dog?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私が持ってきました。ベンチに置いたので、誰でも使える物のように見えたと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分が持参した皿をベンチに置いたため、共用品のように見えたのだと思うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought it myself. I put it on the bench, so I think it looked like something anyone could use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought the bowl yourself but think it looked like a shared item because you put it on the bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用者が取り違えないよう、ご自身で管理してください。今、犬はどこにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep it under your own supervision so other park users do not mistake it. Where is your dog now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私のそばです。皿も自分の荷物の側へ移し、通路には置かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 犬はそばにいて、皿も自分の荷物の側へ移し、通路には置かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My dog is beside me. I will also move the bowl beside my belongings and keep it out of the walkway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your dog is beside you and that you will move the bowl beside your belongings and keep it out of the walkway. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 周りに説明が必要なら、持参した犬用の皿だと伝えましょう。公園の設備だとは案内しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If people need an explanation, tell them it is a bowl you brought for your dog. Please do not describe it as park equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: さっきの人にも、共用ではなく私の犬用だと伝えます。使った水をベンチに流さず、片付け方も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共用ではなく自分の犬用だと利用者に説明し、水をベンチに流さず片付け方も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also tell the person from earlier that it is for my dog, not shared use. I will not pour the used water onto the bench, and I will check how to clean up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain to the park user that the bowl is for your dog rather than shared use, avoid pouring the water onto the bench, and check how to clean up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。ごみや持参物を残さず、利用条件に沿って片付けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. Clean up according to the park's rules without leaving any rubbish or belongings behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 皿を手元で管理し、帰る時に持ち帰ります。置きっぱなしにせず、犬用の持参物だと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 皿を手元で管理して持ち帰り、置きっぱなしにせず持参した犬用の皿だと説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the bowl with me and take it home when I leave. I will not leave it unattended, and I will explain that it is something I brought for my dog.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the bowl with you and take it home, avoid leaving it unattended, and explain that you brought it for your dog. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。周りに配慮してお過ごしください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01226-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please be considerate of others while enjoying the park. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。移動の相談で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you plan your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歌志内の宿へ行きたいです。宿の名前だけで駅を探したので、まず行き先を整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿の名前だけで駅を探していたので、宿へ行くために行き先を整理したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to my accommodation in Utashinai. I searched for a station using only the accommodation's name, so I would first like to sort out my destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you searched for a station using only the accommodation's name and want help clarifying your destination so you can reach the accommodation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宿から届いた案内に、住所と最寄りの交通機関は書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do the directions sent by the accommodation include an address and the nearest transport options?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所はありますが、私は地名が駅名だと思っていました。案内には鉄道の駅とは書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宿の住所は分かるが地名を駅名だと思っており、案内には鉄道の駅とは書かれていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is an address, but I assumed the place name was a station name. The directions do not say it is a railway station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you know the accommodation's address but assumed the place name was a station name, although the directions do not describe it as a railway station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地名だけでは、利用する駅や停留所は決められません。宿から届いた案内で、乗り降りする場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: A place name alone does not tell us which station or stop to use. Let us check the directions from your accommodation for where to board and get off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所を宿へ伝えて確認します。到着の入口も、地図に出た建物の裏側ではないか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宿に住所を示して確認し、利用する入口が地図の建物裏側ではないかも尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will give the address to the accommodation and check. I also want to ask whether the entrance for arrivals is on the back side of the building shown on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the address to the accommodation to confirm it and also ask whether the entrance you should use is at the back of the building on the map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宿に、利用する入口と交通機関からの経路を確認してください。移動上の条件はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please confirm the entrance to use and the route from public transport with your accommodation. Do you have any travel requirements?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大きい荷物があり、長い坂道は避けたいです。距離が短いだけで歩けると決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大きな荷物があり長い坂道は避けたいので、距離が短いだけで歩けるとは判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have large luggage and want to avoid a long slope. I will not decide that I can walk a route just because the distance is short.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have large luggage and want to avoid long slopes, so you will not judge a route walkable solely because the distance is short. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宿から返事が届きました。利用入口は南側で、裏側の短い坂道ではなく、平坦な通りから南側へ回る案内です。地図でその線を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your accommodation has replied. The entrance to use is on the south side. They advise going around to the south side from the flat street, rather than using the short slope at the back. Let us check that route on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 南側入口ですね。裏の短い坂道を選ばず、荷物を持って平坦な通りから回る線を確認します。そこへ行ける現在の交通と乗場は、事業者にも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宿の返答は南側入口で、裏の短い坂道でなく平坦な通りから回ると確認し、その経路へ行ける交通と乗場を事業者にも尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: The south entrance, then. I will check the route around from the flat street with my luggage instead of choosing the short slope at the back. I will also check with the transport operator about the services currently available to get there and where to board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the accommodation says to use the south entrance and go around from the flat street rather than the short slope at the back. Say you will also ask the transport operator which services reach that route and where to board. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認した経路でお気をつけてお出かけください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please travel safely along the route you have checked. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。書類のことで何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申請の電話番号に家族の番号を書きました。私の代わりに全部答えてもらえるか、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申請書の連絡先に家族の番号を書いたので、自分の代わりに全て答えてもらえるか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put a family member's number as the phone number on my application. I would like to check whether they can answer everything on my behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you put a family member's number as the application contact and want to check whether they can answer everything on your behalf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族の番号を書いた理由を教えてください。ご本人へ連絡できる番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me why you put your family member's number. Is there a number where we can reach you directly?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事中は出られないので家族の番号を書きました。でも自分の携帯はあり、18時から19時なら出られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族番号は勤務中に出られないため書いたが、自分の携帯は18〜19時なら出られると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put my family member's number because I cannot answer while working. But I do have my own mobile, and I can answer between 6 and 7 p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you used your family member's number because you cannot answer during work, but you can answer your own mobile between 6 and 7 p.m. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡先と、申請について代わりに答えることは別に確認しましょう。家族に代理をお願いする手続きは済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check contact details separately from having someone answer on your behalf about the application. Have you completed the procedure to appoint your family member as your representative?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: していません。番号を書くことだけで、代理人になるとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代理の手続きはしておらず、電話番号を書くことだけで家族が代理人になるとは考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I will not assume that simply writing their phone number makes them my representative.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not completed the representative procedure and will not assume that writing your family member's phone number makes them your representative. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人に連絡できる番号と時間を担当へ伝えられます。折返しの方法も相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can tell the person in charge the number and times when you can be reached directly. Let us discuss how you can return calls as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の番号へ連絡してもらい、出られない時は折り返したいです。家族には、私へ連絡があったと知らせるだけを頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の番号への連絡と折返しを希望し、家族には着信を知らせるだけを頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like you to call my number, and if I cannot answer, I would like to call back. I will only ask my family to let me know that someone has contacted me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to be contacted on your own number and return missed calls, and will only ask your family to notify you of calls. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当の了解を得て、本人が示した携帯番号へ訂正しました。連絡可能時間は18時から19時と記録しました。登録した番号を、お手元の番号と照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: With the person in charge's agreement, I have changed the contact number to the mobile number you provided. I have recorded your available time as 6 to 7 p.m. Please compare the registered number with the one you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、登録は私の番号と一致し、18時から19時となっています。家族の番号を書いたまま代理回答を頼むのではなく、自分へ連絡を受け、折返しの方法を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録が自分の番号と18〜19時に訂正されたと確認し、家族の代理回答を当然にせず本人連絡と折返し方法を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the registered number matches mine, and the time is 6 to 7 p.m. Rather than leaving my family's number and asking them to answer on my behalf, I will receive the calls myself and check with the person in charge how to call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the registration has been corrected to your own number and 6 to 7 p.m. Say you will discuss direct contact and returning calls instead of assuming your family can answer on your behalf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号と連絡可能時間の訂正を確認できました。代理の手続きが済んだという記録にはしていません。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the corrections to your number and available contact time. I have not recorded the representative procedure as completed. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 健診の結果が届きました。封筒が来たら診察も予約されたと思いましたが、説明を聞く手続きを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 健診結果の封筒が届けば診察も予約済みと思っていたので、結果の説明を聞く手続きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My health check results have arrived. I thought receiving the envelope meant a doctor's appointment had also been booked, but I would like to check the procedure for having the results explained.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought receiving the envelope with your health check results meant a doctor's appointment was already booked, and ask how to arrange an explanation of the results. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒に予約日時や受診方法の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the envelope contain an appointment date and time or instructions on how to see a doctor?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 結果の紙はありますが、予約日時はありません。結果の発送と診察予約を同じに考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 結果の紙はあるが予約日時はなく、結果の発送と診察予約を混同していたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It contains the results, but no appointment date or time. I had been treating the mailing of the results and the booking of a doctor's appointment as the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the results but no appointment date or time, and had confused the mailing of the results with the booking of a doctor's appointment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 説明を希望することを担当へ伝えます。どの内容について聞きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person in charge that you would like an explanation. What would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前の年と数値が違う項目があります。自分で病名を決めず、医師に比べ方を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前年と数値が違う項目があるので、自分で病名を決めず医師に比較の仕方を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Some values differ from the previous year. I do not want to diagnose myself; I would like to ask the doctor how to compare them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that some values differ from the previous year and that you want to ask the doctor how to compare them rather than decide on a diagnosis yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 過去の結果も持って相談できます。現在、急いで伝える体調の変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can bring your earlier results to the consultation too. Are there any current changes in your health that you need to tell us about urgently?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は急に変わった症状はありません。今回は結果の説明を聞きたいです。体調についても、担当者に具体的に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今は急に変わった症状はなく、今回相談したいのは結果の説明で、体調も具体的に伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not currently have any sudden changes in my symptoms. This time, I would like to have the results explained. I will also describe my health condition specifically to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you have no sudden changes in symptoms at present, want an explanation of the results this time, and will also describe your health condition specifically. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が必要な確認をして受診方法をご案内します。予約が必要かも確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will make the necessary checks and explain how to arrange the visit. Let us also check whether an appointment is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今年と昨年の紙を用意し、結果説明の受診方法を聞きます。封筒が来ただけで予約済みとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今年と昨年の結果を用意して説明を聞く受診方法を確認し、封筒の到着だけで予約済みとは判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will prepare this year's and last year's results and ask how to arrange a visit for an explanation. I will not say an appointment is already booked just because the envelope arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare this year's and last year's results and check how to see a doctor for an explanation, without assuming that receiving the envelope means an appointment has been booked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you with the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.
